title: 30 truth or dare questions for couples

slides.title: 30 *truth or dare* questions for couples
slides.sub: Take turns. Two passes each. That’s it.

items.text: What was your *first thought* when you saw me?
items.label: Truth

items.text: Describe me using *only three emojis.*
items.label: Dare

items.text: What’s the most embarrassing thing you did *to impress me?*
items.label: Truth

items.text: Do your best impression of me *waking up.*
items.label: Dare

items.text: Have you ever pretended to like something *because I did?*
items.label: Truth

items.text: Serenade me with *the last song* you played.
items.label: Dare

items.text: Which habit of mine have you *secretly copied?*
items.label: Truth

items.text: Let me pick your *phone wallpaper* for a week.
items.label: Dare

items.text: When did you realize you *liked me?*
items.label: Truth

items.text: Slow dance with me, *no music.*
items.label: Dare

items.text: What’s something you’ve *never told me?*
items.label: Truth

items.text: Give me a *thirty-second* shoulder massage.
items.label: Dare

items.text: What’s your *favorite photo* of me, and why?
items.label: Truth

items.text: Talk in *an accent* for the next three rounds.
items.label: Dare

items.text: What’s the *weirdest dream* you’ve had about me?
items.label: Truth

items.text: Recreate *our first kiss.*
items.label: Dare

items.text: What do you *miss most* when I’m away?
items.label: Truth

items.text: Write me a *two-line love poem*, right now.
items.label: Dare

items.text: Who was your *first ever crush?*
items.label: Truth

items.text: Show me your *most embarrassing* playlist.
items.label: Dare

items.text: What would you change about *our first date?*
items.label: Truth

items.text: Let me style *your hair* however I want.
items.label: Dare

items.text: What’s the *pettiest* thing that annoys you about me?
items.label: Truth

items.text: Call me a *new nickname* for the rest of the night.
items.label: Dare

items.text: What’s the most *romantic* thing I’ve done?
items.label: Truth

items.text: Draw my portrait *in sixty seconds.*
items.label: Dare

items.text: Which day with me would you *relive?*
items.label: Truth

items.text: Plan our next date *in under a minute.*
items.label: Dare

items.text: What’s your *biggest* green flag in me?
items.label: Truth

items.text: Tell me *five things* you love about me. Go.
items.label: Dare

slides.title: Save this *for your next game night.*
slides.sub: Comment which dare you’d never do.
